title: Terraform Workspace
description: A Terraform workspace defines a unit of infrastructure managed by Terraform with its own state, variables, and run history.

name.description: The name of the workspace, unique within the organization

auto-apply.description: When true, runs automatically apply after a successful plan

locked.description: When true, no new runs can be queued

execution-mode.description: Execution mode: remote (HCP), local, or agent pool

terraform-version.description: The version of Terraform used by this workspace

working-directory.description: Subdirectory within the VCS repo for configuration files

created-at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace was created

updated-at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace was last updated

resource-count.description: Number of resources managed by this workspace

environment.description: The environment associated with this workspace (e.g., production, staging)

speculative-enabled.description: Whether speculative plans can be run on pull requests

global-remote-state.description: Whether other workspaces can access this workspace's state

organization.description: The organization this workspace belongs to

project.description: The project this workspace is grouped under
